thread:
nina: Quick blocker on docs PR #521 — I added an SDK snippet that uses `client.stream()` and mentions "stream cancels are propagated to runtime". CI preview is green but runtime folks: is that exact phrasing accurate?
omar: can you paste the snippet? my worry is users will think cancel always aborts GPU work; in reality we cancel request processing but the runtime may still complete some background work (KV flush, metrics).
nina: snippet: 
```
with client.stream(route='chat') as s:
  s.send('hi')
  s.cancel()
```

nina: PR text: "Cancelling a stream tells the server to stop processing and will free capacity." Should we soften that?
ben: hold merge until wording clarified. Suggest: "Cancelling a stream requests the server stop producing additional output; runtime attempts to interrupt model execution but may complete in-flight token generation and internal cleanup."
runtime: precise behavior: cancel triggers request-level cancellation; runtime will attempt immediate interruption but may finish current token batch and commit KV/cache updates. No guarantees about GPU memory/duty cycle reclaim timing. Also, streaming cancel does not imply rollback of side-effects from tool calls; tool calls are delivered as soon as invoked.
nina: ok that matches what we need. I'll update phrasing to your suggestion and add a short note: "tool calls may still run to completion even if the client cancels."
omar: also add a brief sentence on SDK behavior: `stream.cancel()` maps to `request_context.cancel()` and the server responds with a `cancelled` event.
ci-bot: preview for PR #521 deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/521 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
docs-bot: label "merge-on-runtime-confirmation" added by docs-bot.
ben: one more edge: streaming + function calling + hidden background reranks can result in partial outputs; recommend adding a short example showing a cleanup hook in SDK to handle partial function responses.
nina: will add tiny code comment and push. PTAL after I push.
omar: LGTM after wording + small SDK mapping note. ben: ack.
docs-bot: note added: "requires runtime ack on cancel semantics"
nina: pushed update. merging during the small-window after omar's +1. Thanks all. :tada:
